currentParagraphText: “Does it defend against anything else besides teleportation?” the Sword Saint asked curiously.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Does it defend against anything else besides teleportation?” the Sword Saint asked curiously.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Yes, like the atmosphere of a planet, it also defends against external attacks and even invasions through flight,” Artemis continued. “Moreover, the Mother Tree is connected to the entire barrier and knows of anyone and everything that goes through it. There are very few existences in the multiverse that can sneak in unnoticed... the Seeker counted amongst them.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “The formation isn’t merely a thin barrier, but covers a vast distance... think about it almost like the atmosphere of a planet, just one that covers the entire Supercluster,” Artemis explained as they flew through space.
